title: Measuring the Model-Card Transparency Gap with a Public Scoring Pipeline

original_idea.body: Measuring the Model-Card Transparency Gap with a Public Scoring Pipeline

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Transparency scoring supports regulation but reimplements an existing rubric; chain to catastrophic risk has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Standard tools, public model cards, LLM scoring; beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped (20-40 cards, fixed rubric, clear compliance scores).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Mostly a replication of the Atlas rubric on new cards; overlaps existing indices.

novelty.reasoning: Largely a reimplementation of the published AI Transparency Atlas rubric.
